collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A worn-out villager has been told to rest and feels terrible about it: stay in the hammock, or get up and do a little.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been unwell for a week, nothing serious, just worn out and coughing. (friend) has told (subject.him/her) to rest. Properly. Lying down, no working, no "just carrying a few things." (subject) is lying in (subject.his/her) hammock and feeling terrible about it. Everyone else is working. (subject.He/she) can hear them.

choices.label: Get Up and Do a Little

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) stays. It's agonizing. Every time someone walks past, (subject.he/she) wants to explain that (subject.he/she) is resting on the healer's orders and not just lazy. Nobody asks. Nobody thinks it. On the fourth day (subject.he/she) finally falls asleep in the afternoon, deeply, like a stone, and wakes up feeling more like (subject.him/her)self than (subject.he/she) has in weeks.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) gets up and does a little, then a little more. By the evening (subject.he/she) is coughing worse. (friend) sits down beside (subject.him/her). "Resting isn't the same as doing nothing," (friend.he/she) says gently. "It's what your body is working on right now. Let it." (subject) lies back down. It still feels wrong. (subject.He/she) does it anyway, because (subject.he/she) is too tired not to.
